messages:
sara (docs): Heads up: I noticed our chat streaming doc shows SSE events wrapping a full "completion" object in each data payload, but the runtime actually sends incremental "delta" events with partial text and token info. This is causing confusion in the Python SSE snippet.

matt (sdk): Can you paste the problematic snippet? I thought we standardized on delta events months ago.

sara (docs): In docs/reference/chat-streaming.md the example SSE event is documented like this:

```
data: { "completion": { "id": "c_123", "text": "partial text" } }
```

But the live endpoint emits:

```
data: { "delta": { "id": "c_123", "role": "assistant", "content": "partial text" }, "done": false }
```

Also our Python example (sseclient) expects `event['data']['completion']['text']` which raises KeyError.

ravi (api): Runtime: we changed the streaming contract to `delta` to support structured tokens (role changes, tool calls, token ids). The docs team must show the `delta` shape and update SDK examples. Backwards compat: we do emit a final `done:true` event with the assembled completion id, but not wrapped under `completion` key per-event.

tina (eng): Ops confirmation: proxy and SSE gateway don't transform payload shape, so docs must match runtime. There's also a note: we send events with Content-Type: text/event-stream and each event's data is JSON.

matt (sdk): I'll update Python and Node SSE helpers to parse `delta` objects. For Python snippet we should show how to accumulate `delta['content']` into a final string and how to handle role/tool-call deltas.

sara (docs): Proposed doc changes: 1) Replace `completion`-wrapped examples with `delta`-based examples. 2) Add a small example accumulator snippet for Python and Node. 3) Add a short compatibility note pointing to the final assembly event: the last event contains `done: true` and `id`. 4) Update param table to clarify `streaming` is indicated by Accept header + endpoint `/v1/chat/stream`.

ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 by matt (sdk) 2 checks triggered

matt (sdk): PR includes: updated docs/reference/chat-streaming.md (SSE examples), added examples/snippets/accumulate-sse.py and accumulate-sse.js, updated SDK helper docstrings. Also added test that parses example SSE stream with both delta and done events.

sara (docs): Can we include a short JSON example of a tool-call delta? People keep asking about function/tool calls mid-stream.

ravi (api): Sure — tool call delta looks like: `{ "delta": { "tool_call": { "name": "search", "args": "..." } } }`. Note: tool_call may be split across multiple deltas; clients should buffer until `tool_call.done` or until a non-tool token is seen. We'll document that.

matt (sdk): Adding a small note and example. Also will add a one-line warning: "If you migrate from older samples that expect `completion` per-event, update your accumulator to read `delta` and to look for the final `done:true` event."

sara (docs): CI preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/812/reference/chat-streaming.html

ci-bot: docs lint found two link warnings in the migration note. matt (sdk) pushed a fix.

matt (sdk): All checks green now. Also updated the Node SSE snippet to use `event.data.delta` safely with try/catch.

sara (docs): Quick checklist before merge: update examples, add accumulator snippets, add tool-call streaming example, update param table, run linkcheck.

julia (pm): (joining) Is this a breaking change? Should we notify customers who use raw SSE parsing?

ravi (api): Behavior has been in place for months; this is strictly a docs correction. We should still call out in release notes for clarity.

julia (pm): Ok add a short blurb under Release Notes -> Docs clarifications. Assign to @sara.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #812.

matt (sdk): Merged. @sara please add the release-note blurb and ping engineering slack channel.

sara (docs): Draft blurb: "Docs: clarified SSE event format for chat streaming — runtime emits `delta` events (partial role/content/tool deltas). Updated accumulation examples for Python/Node. See docs PR #812."

julia (pm): LGTM. Thanks for the cleanup. :rocket:

sara (docs): Closing this thread. If anyone spots other streaming examples (tutorials or SDK guides), tag me and I'll sweep them.
